verdict.rationale: The durability docs list a Free plan with 99.999999999% durability, so free-tier data is stored durably. A community user reports running on the free tier without needing more, and another notes near-zero cold starts. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents idle databases scaling to zero or a pay-nothing-when-idle mechanism, so the cost story rests on the free tier rather than a scale-to-zero feature. Missing for 10: explicit scale-to-zero/idle behavior docs, free-tier limits and pricing detail, independent confirmation that idle databases incur no cost.
